verdict.rationale: Notion documents a first-party agent you chat with: Agent API sessions let you start a chat, stream the agent's reply and submit actions. Its official MCP server lets natural-language clients like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex search, read, create and update pages and databases. Marketing adds agents that work 24/7 and instant answers with citations, plus Skills for repeatable natural-language workflows. Missing for 10: detailed docs on in-app natural-language command coverage (which operations the built-in agent can perform), and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably.
